issues.detail: Developer authored test/export.test.ts and test/integration/export-flow.test.ts as self-check harnesses (DEV-001, DEV-003), although the developer template says not to create Tester-owned tests. This is realistic, and a correct Tester simply reuses them as existing coverage. It also gives assertion 1 more material, because the Tester has to judge whether those tests are valid evidence rather than inherit them. Some runs might mention it, but it does not change what is tested.

Assertion 2 is complete:false with BlockedOn/PendingCycleBlockedOn/PendingVerificationCadence equal NONE and check_ok as preconditions. This is reasonable because 'no new state field' needs the judge to read the STATE.md diff. Every precondition holds under any correct run, whether it stays in TESTING or hands off to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION.

summary: The export-testing base unchanged realizes every stated condition: brownfield STANDARD TESTING with the named cycle, current-cycle scope, design, and plan, valid context, inactive recovery, no report, and a correct implementation whose AC-002 Developer evidence is inspection-only. Checks and invariants are necessary conditions that any correct run satisfies, and nothing in the tree leaks the expected behavior. Only minor realism notes remain.
